integrity.critical_inputs: The local geometric-Serre criterion and S2 classification are from arXiv:2610.01146v1; the type-A minimal-orbit cohomology and cotangent-bundle topology are independently available in arXiv:0704.3417v2.
integrity.proof_boundary: The packaged checker verifies only dimension/range arithmetic. The universal topology and sheaf-theoretic implications are proved in RESULT.md from the cited theorems.

scientific_limitations: Coefficients are the complex numbers and the constructible category is taken with respect to the natural two-stratum orbit stratification.
The new uniform assertion is for type A; no statement is made for other simple Lie types.
The zero geometric-MCM category concerns constructible sheaves and does not contradict the existence of coherent algebraic MCM sheaves on the same singularities.
title: Exact geometric Serre depth three on type-A minimal nilpotent cones
